title: eludite.git.unstage input
description: Unstage files (Git Changes: Unstage, `-`; Unstage All): their index entries go back to HEAD's (removed when HEAD has none); the working tree is untouched. The repository is the one discovered from the open workspace (solution folder or opened folder) upward, as `git` discovers it; without one the command fails naming eludite.git.init.

paths.description: Paths relative to the repository root, or absolute paths inside its working tree.
